title: El Catador de Matatlán, MAJESTIC STORIES
comment: copita-matatlan (MAJESTIC): puesto en la feria del mezcal de Santiago Matatlán, Oaxaca. Caras comunes, no famosas; los cuatro se distinguen a simple vista.

chars.TEOFILO_RUIZ: Zapotec Mexican man from Oaxaca, 74 years old, deep brown weathered skin, short white hair, a thin white mustache, calm eyes, a worn palm-leaf hat, a simple white cotton long-sleeve shirt, dark trousers, leather huaraches, his hands empty.
chars.IKER_LASCURAIN: Mexican man, trendy mezcal producer, 35 years old, light skin, styled brown hair with short sides, a short trimmed beard, a beige linen shirt with rolled-up sleeves and open collar, a thin silver chain, dark jeans, white sneakers, his hands empty.
chars.DANIELA_MORA: Mexican woman, 30 years old, fair skin, long straight dyed-blond hair, big sunglasses pushed up on her head, a white linen blouse with long sleeves, light jeans, white sneakers, her hands empty.
chars.BRIGIDA_ORTEGA: Mexican woman, important mezcal buyer, 52 years old, light-brown skin, short black hair, red lipstick, large silver earrings, a black blazer over a colorful embroidered Oaxacan blouse, black trousers, her hands empty.

locs.LOC_FERIAMATATLAN: Mezcal fair stall in Santiago Matatlán, Oaxaca, at midday: a rustic wooden counter with clay cups and unlabeled glass bottles of mezcal, colorful papel picado without letters hanging overhead, other stalls blurred, agave fields and dry hills beyond, bright sun, no readable text, no signs, no logos, no people.
